description: Beta frontend for Windows app stores and package managers, including Microsoft Store, WinGet, and Chocolatey.
notes: The latest published GitHub release is v0.4.0-beta (published March 10, 2025); this is a beta release, not a stable release.
This is the official interactive installer, not a portable build. It registers the Fluent Store MSIX package and requires administrator approval to trust its signing certificate.
The installer may download and install the .NET Desktop Runtime if a compatible version is missing; an internet connection is required.
Scoop uninstall removes the current user's Fluent Store MSIX package. The app package is not stored as an ordinary portable folder under the Scoop app directory.

script: if (-not $release) { throw 'No FluentStore beta release containing the x64 installer was found.' }
